entries.EN:
One of the final developments in the long line of Mauser military rifles and the standard service rifle of the German Wehrmacht, the Kar98 was selected by Nazi Germany for its exceptional accuracy and effectiveness in long distance situations. In skilled hands, these rifles had an effective range of up to 1000 meters.

A semi-automatic, gas-operated, self-loading carbine used primarily during the Cold War, the SKS still sees service today with second-line and reserve army units. As it lacked a fire select and was limited to 10 rounds, it was made obsolete by the AK-47.

entries.EN: SVD
entries.JA_new: SVD

entries.EN:
One of the most iconic sniper rifles despite not technically being a sniper rifle, the SVD was intended to provide precise, suppressive fire on enemy positions as well as pick off high value targets. However, this squad-level DMR was eventually pressed into service as a sniper by those with access to nothing else. Relatively light, precise and well-balanced, it unfortunately loses out to dedicated sniper rifles in performance but is nonetheless a great firearm.

entries.EN:
A portable, shoulder-launched, anti-tank rocket-propelled grenade launcher. It is the most widely used anti-armor weapon in the world and has been used in many conflicts since the 1960s. The RPG-7 is effective against lightly armored vehicles, fortified targets, and unarmored targets. However, it has limited accuracy and penetration against modern, heavily armored vehicles, such as main battle tanks. The RPG-7 can also be used against helicopters, but requires skill and luck to hit a moving target.

A portable, shoulder-launched, anti-tank rocket-propelled grenade launcher. It is the most widely used anti-armor weapon in the world and has been used in many conflicts since the 1960s. The RPG-7 is effective against lightly armored vehicles, fortified targets, and unarmored targets. However, it has limited accuracy and penetration against modern, heavily armored vehicles, such as main battle tanks. The RPG-7 can also be used against helicopters, but requires skill and luck to hit a moving target.

entries.JA_new:
肩に担いで発射する携行式対戦車ロケット推進グレネードランチャー。世界で最も広く使われる対装甲兵器で、1960年代以降、数多くの紛争で使用されてきた。軽装甲車両、要塞化された目標、非装甲目標に有効。ただし、主力戦車のような現代の重装甲車両に対しては、命中精度と貫通力に限界がある。ヘリコプターにも使用できるが、移動目標に命中させるには技量と運が必要だ。
